subject: Temporary analytics relay onboarding — export assurance and evidence
messages:
From: Anna Rees <anna.rees@metrobank.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-04T08:14:00Z
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + short-term analytics relay evidence

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our procurement checklist we need a short subprocessor disclosure for the temporary analytics relay you mentioned (the lightweight relay that collects anonymized telemetry during our pilot).

Can you please provide: 
- The current list of subprocessors involved in that relay (names + country of processing)
- A one-page summary of data paths (what data is routed to the relay, retention, and whether any PII can travel)
- Any SOC2 / encryption attestations or a pointer to an evidence bundle we can share with our security team

We'd like this by EOD Friday to keep the procurement timeline. If the relay uses any cross-border transit outside the EU, please call that out explicitly and confirm safeguards.

Appreciate it —
Anna Rees
Senior Contracts Manager
MetroBank

Attachment: procurement_requirements_metrobank.pdf (pdf stub)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Anna Rees <anna.rees@metrobank.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-04T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + short-term analytics relay evidence

Anna —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick summary up-front: the temporary analytics relay is a telemetry-forwarder used only during pilot windows; it never receives raw request bodies and is configured to drop any identifiable fields before export. Still, I want to make sure we give you everything you and your security team need.

Mapping we will provide by COB today:
- Subprocessor roster (service, vendor contact, processing country, role)
- Data path one-pager (diagram + bullet points on retention and redaction)
- Evidence links: SOC2 link for the relay host, TLS encryption details, and our config checklist for redaction

Cc'ing Irene from Security and Kim from Legal to confirm there are no contract-level exceptions for cross-border transit. If either of you want to add or amend anything to the evidence bundle please jump in.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (csv stub)

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Anna Rees <anna.rees@metrobank.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + short-term analytics relay evidence

Diego / Anna —

I reviewed the draft roster Diego shared. Quick clarifications for MetroBank security: 
1) Relay host: EdgeMetrics Ltd (UK) — processes aggregated telemetry only; retention for relay outputs is 7 days by default (configurable to 0 or 3 on request).
2) Transit: aggregated artifacts are replicated to our EU analytics bucket (GCP europe-west1). No routing to US regions for this relay.
3) Encryption & attestations: TLS 1.3 in transit; data at rest in the GCP bucket is encrypted with CMEK (customer-facing key options available under Dedicated customers). We reference our SOC2 Type II summary here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_onboard-metrobank (evidence index).

Note: Relay configuration includes a redaction pipeline that strips fields matching account_id, ssn, email patterns before any export. We also include a small sample sanitized payload in the evidence bundle for your review.

Action items: 
- Diego: finalize the roster CSV to include vendor contacts and a boolean "cross-border" flag.
- Kim: confirm whether MetroBank's DPA requires an addendum for EdgeMetrics (short-term).

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Quoted: 
> On 2027-12-04 11:02, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Mapping we will provide by COB today:...

Attachment(s): onboarding_evidence_summary.pdf (pdf stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Anna Rees <anna.rees@metrobank.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-06T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor roster + short-term analytics relay evidence

Hi Anna —

Thanks for your patience. We've attached the requested roster and an evidence summary. Short answers to your earlier asks: 
- Cross-border transit: none for the pilot — all relay outputs will remain in GCP europe-west1. We've set the "cross_border" flag to false in the roster.
- PII: relay is configured to redact/pseudonymize before export; we do not forward request bodies.
- Attestations: SOC2 summary and TLS/CMEK notes are in the evidence folder (link below). If MetroBank requires a DPA addendum to specifically name EdgeMetrics Ltd as a short-term subprocessor, we can accommodate with a 30-day notice clause.

Evidence & files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_onboard-metrobank
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-Deal-34821

Next step: please confirm if the evidence bundle is sufficient or if procurement wants a signed addendum naming EdgeMetrics. Once you confirm, Legal will prepare the addendum draft (if required).

Best —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
